competition.description: 3D time-lapse microscopy cell detection, lineage linking, and division reconstruction.
competition.prediction_target: A cell graph with detections, temporal links, and division events; metric is adjusted edge Jaccard with a division component.
competition.models: DoG/Hungarian; U-Net + transformer + ILP; association MLP ranker; harmonic fusion; edge-stage TTA; an independent three-classical-model heatmap ensemble; controlled post-processing.
competition.standing: Ongoing; best public 0.917 (Exp203 classical three-model ensemble, 55626138); rank #300/2661 with bronze at ~top 266, so currently outside the medal zone; final private/rank not available
competition.lesson: Two 2026-08-22 brackets both inverted their hypotheses, in opposite directions. Removing line-fit smoothing was predicted to gain against a 2um centroid cliff and instead lost 0.009, with the weight bracket monotone in favour of MORE smoothing. Loading DeepCenter from best.pt instead of checkpoint_last.pt turned a veto that had rejected every division into a selective gate and gained 0.001 - so an earlier negative result had been measuring a bad checkpoint. Check which artifact a component loads before concluding the component is wrong.

nodes.title: Line-fit smoothing OFF (exp183 base)
nodes.summary: Disabling the only stage that moves coordinates LOST 0.009. The centroid-cliff reasoning predicted a gain and was wrong: smoothing corrects detector jitter far more than it displaces true centroids.

nodes.title: Line-fit weight 0.4 (exp183 base)
nodes.summary: Half pull also lost, but less than removing it. With 0.8 = 0.915 the bracket is monotone in the weight, so the optimum is at or ABOVE the shipped 0.8 - the axis is live, in the opposite direction to the hypothesis.

nodes.title: Exp222 line-fit off on the 0.917 stack
nodes.summary: Line-fit off ported to the 0.917 classical stack, held pending the exp183 bracket. The bracket came back monotone AGAINST removing smoothing, so this was never submitted. The live follow-up on this stack is raising LINEFIT_WEIGHT above 0.8, not zeroing it.
nodes.score: Not submitted - the bracket refuted its premise

nodes.title: Exp220 DeepCenter best.pt + safe-division veto
nodes.summary: DeepCenter from best.pt (epoch 2) with the safe-division veto ON: 0.915 -> 0.916, the first gain built on the exp183 base. Exp158 ran the same veto on checkpoint_last.pt (epoch 500), where it rejected ALL divisions for 0.905; on best.pt it retains 244 of 311. The checkpoint caused that failure, not the gate. Companion Exp221 (veto off) was byte-identical to Exp183, so the gap veto is inert and this isolates the safe-division veto alone.

nodes.title: Exp223 wide safe-div + DeepCenter veto
nodes.summary: The public 0.923 cluster differs from the 0.920 recipe by exactly three keys, all safe-division geometry (4.66->12.0, 8.5->15.0, 7.65->10.0), verified by diffing two byte-identical public configs. This applies that widening on top of Exp220.

nodes.title: Exp224 wide safe-div only
nodes.summary: Same widening without the DeepCenter veto. With Exp183 (0.915, narrow, no veto) and Exp220 (0.916, narrow, veto) this completes a 2x2, so a gain is attributable to the geometry, the veto, or their interaction.
